role: Standing coding standard: refactor principles, process, structure rules, safety protocol and a hard-gate completion checklist that every change is measured against.
toplevel: Markdown only. Four checklist items (≤20-line functions, nesting ≤2, no commented-out code, no empty catches) are measured by scripts/check_refactor_spec_conformance.sh against .ci/spec_* budgets; the rest are judgement calls with no gate.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification
units.does: No behavioural claim: title.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Purpose
units.does: No behavioural claim: states purpose (principles, not features) and links MAINTAINERS.md, README, USERS_MANUAL, ARCHITECTURE, FLOWCHART, VOICE_AND_TOOL_USE, API_REFERENCE (all exist).

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Core Philosophy
units.does: No behavioural claim: four core-philosophy bullets.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Vocabulary Contract (Framework-Agnostic)
units.does: No behavioural claim: vocabulary definitions (module boundary, public API, side-effect boundary, explicit wiring, typed errors, structured logging, test doubles).

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Non-Negotiable Principles
units.does: No behavioural claim: header for the seven non-negotiable principles.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Non-Negotiable Principles > 1) Pure Functions First
units.does: Rule: every function that can be pure must be pure; side effects isolated at the boundary. Not mechanically enforced.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Non-Negotiable Principles > 2) Immutable Data Flow
units.does: Rule: one-directional data flow, no shared mutable state, value semantics. The repo keeps shared mutable singletons (e.g. TrainingMetricsCache.shared, FeatureFlags.shared) reached through AppDependencies; not enforced by a gate.
calls: .github/workflows/ci.yml::step lint-and-budgets/Singletons read only in the composition root

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Non-Negotiable Principles > 3) Single Responsibility — For Real
units.does: Rule: one responsibility per function/module. Not mechanically enforced.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Non-Negotiable Principles > 4) Small Functions, Meaningful Names
units.does: Rule: functions 5-15 lines target, 20 yellow, 30+ broken up; assertion-style boolean names. Enforced at ≤20 lines by check_refactor_spec_conformance.sh with .ci/spec_long_functions_budget.txt = 0 and 7 justified waivers (.ci/spec_justified_long_budget.txt).

flags.text: The '<=20 lines (rare, justified exceptions only)' rule is gated by check_refactor_spec_conformance.sh, whose header says the waiver budget 'is zero'; .ci/spec_justified_long_budget.txt is 7, so seven waived long functions pass the gate while its documentation claims none can.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Non-Negotiable Principles > 5) Composition Over Inheritance
units.does: Rule: composition over inheritance; protocols only when they reduce coupling/duplication. MAINTAINERS §5.7 records three single-conformer protocols removed for this reason.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Non-Negotiable Principles > 6) Explicit Error Handling
units.does: Rule: no swallowed errors, no empty catch blocks, visible failure modes. Gate: check_refactor_spec_conformance.sh hard-zero on empty catches; try? capped by .ci/try_optional_budget.txt (170) via enforce_tech_debt_budgets.sh.

flags.text: Spec says 'No empty catch blocks' without exception; the repo sanctions a `swallow-ok:` waiver marker for empty catches (documented in MAINTAINERS §10) and uses it in production code, and keeps 170 permitted silent try? sites.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Non-Negotiable Principles > 7) Zero Tolerance for Magic
units.does: Rule: no implicit dependencies, global mutable state, hidden side effects or stringly-typed APIs. .shared reads are confined to the composition root by check_no_shared_outside_root.sh; global singletons still exist behind AppDependencies.
calls: .github/workflows/ci.yml::step lint-and-budgets/Singletons read only in the composition root

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactoring Process
units.does: No behavioural claim: header for the refactoring process.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactoring Process > Step 1: Audit
units.does: Process: audit a module (purpose, inputs/outputs, state, side effects, implicit deps, deletion impact) before changing it. No code counterpart.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactoring Process > Step 2: Extract Pure Logic
units.does: Process: extract pure logic out of side-effecting code. No code counterpart (MAINTAINERS §5.2 lists types lifted this way).

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactoring Process > Step 3: Establish Data Flow
units.does: Process: refactor toward Input → Validate → Transform → Process → Format → Output with side effects at the edges. No code counterpart.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactoring Process > Step 4: Name Everything
units.does: Process: rename until identifiers read as documentation. No code counterpart.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactoring Process > Step 5: Enforce Module Boundaries
units.does: Process: clean public API, private internals, one-way dependencies. No code counterpart or gate.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactoring Process > Step 6: Handle Every Edge Case
units.does: Process: account for empty/invalid input, partial failure, timeouts, cleanup, concurrency; no default that hides a broken state. No code counterpart.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Code Structure Standards
units.does: No behavioural claim: header for structure standards.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Code Structure Standards > File Organization
units.does: Rule: one concern per module, group by feature/domain not generic technical layer names, keep helpers close, delete unused exports.

flags.text: Spec says to group by feature/domain, not by generic technical layer names; the app source is grouped exactly by technical layer (Views/, ViewModels/, Services/, Utilities/, Models/, Protocols/), which MAINTAINERS §2 presents as the intended structure.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Code Structure Standards > Function Ordering Within a File
units.does: Rule: order members public API → pure core → side-effect adapters → private helpers. Not enforced.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Code Structure Standards > Explicit Dependency Wiring (No Hidden Instantiation)
units.does: Rule: dependencies created only in the wiring layer and passed in. Implemented by AppDependencies + RRCollector.makeDefault (per MAINTAINERS §9.4); production code still defaults init parameters to AppDependencies.current (e.g. TrainingLoadPrecedence.stored ftp default reads AppDependencies.current at TrainingLoadPrecedence.swift:85).

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Functional Patterns to Apply
units.does: No behavioural claim: header for functional patterns.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Functional Patterns to Apply > Pipeline / Compose
units.does: Guidance: turn do-everything functions into pipelines of small steps. No code counterpart.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Functional Patterns to Apply > Map / Filter / Reduce Over Manual Loops
units.does: Guidance: prefer map/filter/reduce unless a loop is clearer. No code counterpart.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Functional Patterns to Apply > Closures for Configuration
units.does: Guidance: bind configuration with closures. No code counterpart.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Functional Patterns to Apply > Option/Result Shapes Over Null Checks
units.does: Guidance: prefer Optional/Result shapes over sentinel values. No code counterpart.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > What NOT to Do
units.does: Rule list: no sweeping rewrites, while-I'm-here changes, style-only refactors, net-new abstractions, metaprogramming cleanups, new global/hidden state. Not enforced.
calls: .github/workflows/ci.yml::step lint-and-budgets/Singletons read only in the composition root

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Eliminate Bloat, Duplication, and Dead Weight
units.does: No behavioural claim: header for bloat/duplication/dead-weight rules.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Eliminate Bloat, Duplication, and Dead Weight > Dead Code Removal
units.does: Rule: delete unused code; prove use or quarantine then delete. Gate: scripts/check_no_orphan_swift.sh (ci.yml:379) checks only that Swift files are in the project, not unused symbols.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Eliminate Bloat, Duplication, and Dead Weight > Duplication Elimination (DRY — But Smart)
units.does: Rule: remove duplication of the same concept only. Not enforced.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Eliminate Bloat, Duplication, and Dead Weight > Bloat Reduction
units.does: Rule: fewer files/types/layers/knobs. Not enforced.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Eliminate Bloat, Duplication, and Dead Weight > Dependency Audit
units.does: Rule: every dependency must earn its place. SBOM drift is checked (generate_sbom.py --check, ci.yml:171); no gate measures necessity.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Eliminate Bloat, Duplication, and Dead Weight > Size Benchmarks
units.does: Guidance: files readable in one sitting. Gate: .ci/large_swift_files_1500_budget.txt = 0 via enforce_tech_debt_budgets.sh.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Concurrency Safety
units.does: Rule: explicit, guarded concurrency with owned background work. Enforced by Swift 6 strict concurrency (check_strict_concurrency_enabled.sh, ci.yml job strict-concurrency) and the @unchecked Sendable budget (14).

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Testability Contract
units.does: Rule: every refactored module ships test scaffolding, tests for each pure function, test doubles for injected deps, parity tests. Coverage floors in .ci/min_coverage*.txt (44 / 45 / 43.5) are the only mechanical check.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Migration Safety
units.does: Rule: parity tests, preserved formats and side effects, round-trip validation, recorded fixtures. Not enforced.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Logging and Observability
units.does: Rule: structured logging at every side-effect boundary with correlation IDs, consistent levels, no sensitive data. Redaction is gated by scripts/check_log_redaction.sh (ci.yml:324); correlation IDs are not checked.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Performance-Sensitive Paths
units.does: Rule: identify hot paths and measure after refactor. performance.yml (manual) runs AnalysisPerformanceTests.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Data Model Versioning
units.does: Rule: persisted structures versioned/migratable. SessionArchiveEntry.currentSchemaVersion = 1 (SessionMetadata.swift:711) and Archive deferred migrations exist.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > API Contract Stability
units.does: Rule: no public API change in refactors without a compatibility layer. Forwarder files (e.g. HealthKitManager+SleepQueryForwarding.swift, RRCollector+*Forwarding.swift) are the repo's compatibility layers.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Graceful Degradation and Recovery
units.does: Rule: degrade with explicit signals, no silent fallbacks, bounded observable retries, deterministic recovery. Not enforced.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactor Safety Protocol
units.does: No behavioural claim: header for the refactor safety protocol.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactor Safety Protocol > Before Touching Anything
units.does: Process: build and run first, map entry points, snapshot behaviour, mark side effects. No code counterpart.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactor Safety Protocol > During the Refactor
units.does: Process: one change at a time, keep it working, never mix refactor and behaviour change, preserve edge cases, no new surface. No code counterpart.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactor Safety Protocol > After the Refactor
units.does: Process: run full verification suite, manually verify, read whole diff, remove temporary dual paths. `make ci` is the full suite.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactor Safety Protocol > The Cardinal Rule
units.does: Rule: a refactor that cannot be proven behaviour-identical is not complete. No code counterpart.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactor Completion Checklist (Hard Gate)
units.does: No behavioural claim: header for the hard-gate checklist; only four items are measured (see check_refactor_spec_conformance.sh header).

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactor Completion Checklist (Hard Gate) > Correctness & Parity
units.does: Checklist: parity verified, edge cases preserved, full suite passes with zero new warnings. Warnings are capped at 81 by .ci/swiftlint_warning_budget.txt (enforce_swiftlint_budget.sh), not zero-new.

flags.text: doc's hard gate requires the suite to pass with zero new warnings; the SwiftLint gate only fails when total violations exceed the fixed budget of 81 and, unlike other budgets, reports no slack, so new lint warnings pass silently whenever the count is below 81

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactor Completion Checklist (Hard Gate) > Purity, State, and Flow
units.does: Checklist: purity, no shared mutable state, one-directional flow. Not measured.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactor Completion Checklist (Hard Gate) > Boundaries & Dependencies
units.does: Checklist: side effects at boundaries, explicit wiring, no cycles. .shared confinement measured by check_no_shared_outside_root.sh.
calls: .github/workflows/ci.yml::step lint-and-budgets/Singletons read only in the composition root

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactor Completion Checklist (Hard Gate) > Clarity & Complexity
units.does: Checklist: nesting ≤2 and functions ≤20 lines (measured by check_refactor_spec_conformance.sh, budgets 0 plus 7 justified-long waivers), no zero-value wrappers, no single-implementation interfaces. The repo keeps many one-line forwarders (e.g. RRCollector.gatherOvernightData, HealthKitManager.estimateSleepFromHR) deliberately as call-site compatibility shims.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactor Completion Checklist (Hard Gate) > Errors & Observability
units.does: Checklist: explicit error handling, taxonomy, logging with correlation IDs, no sensitive data in logs. Empty catches and log redaction are gated; the rest is not.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactor Completion Checklist (Hard Gate) > Data, Config, and Magic
units.does: Checklist: no magic numbers/strings in logic, constants centralized and named; explicit config; compatible persisted models. No gate measures the magic-number item: check_refactor_spec_conformance.sh delegates it to SwiftLint, and neither .swiftlint.yml nor .swiftlint-strict.yml enables a magic-number rule (no 'magic' entry in either).

flags.text: The hard-gate item 'No magic numbers in logic' is claimed covered by SwiftLint in the conformance gate's header, but no SwiftLint config enables a magic-number rule, so the item is unmeasured and inline thresholds persist in scoring/selection code.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactor Completion Checklist (Hard Gate) > Hygiene & Footprint
units.does: Checklist: dead/commented code removed (commented code budget 0), duplication reduced, line count not increased, dependencies audited.

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Refactor Completion Checklist (Hard Gate) > Performance & Reliability
units.does: Checklist: hot paths measured, graceful degradation, bounded retries. Not measured.

flags.text: doc lists 'performance measured post-refactor' under a Hard Gate; the only harness is a workflow_dispatch-only workflow running one measure() test with no committed .xcbaseline, so a performance regression never fails any CI run

units.key: § Code Refactor Specification > Final Standard (Definition of Done)
units.does: Definition of done: obvious responsibility, pure core, swappable deps, explicit errors, no silent failure, dead code removed, tests, parity, no new global/hidden state or magic. Not measured as a whole.
